description: Code optimization and bug fixes - security user-scoping, CORS ordering, race conditions, page limit fix, automated tests

userStories.title: Add user-scoping to list_documents endpoint
userStories.description: As a user, I want to only see my own documents so that other users cannot view my files.
acceptanceCriteria: list_documents endpoint accepts current_user via get_optional_user dependency
When authenticated, filters Document.user_id == current_user.id
When unauthenticated, returns only documents with user_id IS NULL
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add user-scoping to delete_document endpoint
userStories.description: As a user, I want to ensure only I can delete my own documents so that my files are protected from other users.
acceptanceCriteria: delete_document endpoint accepts current_user via get_optional_user dependency
Returns 403 if document.user_id != current_user.id (and document has a user_id)
Unauthenticated users can only delete documents with user_id IS NULL
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add user-scoping to document detail endpoints
userStories.description: As a user, I want document detail endpoints to verify ownership so that other users cannot access my document content.
acceptanceCriteria: get_document_status, list_document_slides, list_document_explanations verify document.user_id matches current user
Returns 404 (not 403) when document belongs to another user (prevents enumeration)
Unauthenticated access still works for documents with user_id IS NULL
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Fix CORS middleware ordering
userStories.description: As a developer, I need CORS headers to be properly injected on all responses so that the frontend can handle errors correctly.
acceptanceCriteria: In main.py, swap middleware order: add RequestLoggingMiddleware first, then CORSMiddleware (Starlette applies in reverse, so CORS becomes outermost)
CORS headers appear on 4xx/5xx error responses from cross-origin requests
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Fix check_monthly_page_limit to count pages not rows
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the monthly page limit to count actual pages processed, not LLMUsage rows.
acceptanceCriteria: Check LLMUsage model for page_count field; if absent, sum Document.page_count for user's documents created this month
check_monthly_page_limit returns accurate page count
get_usage_stats returns consistent page count
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Need to check LLMUsage model schema first to determine approach

userStories.title: Cancel background polling when document changes
userStories.description: As a user, I want background polling to stop when I switch documents so stale updates don't overwrite my current view.
acceptanceCriteria: handleUpload stores an AbortController ref for the background polling IIFE
loadDocument cancels any active background poll before starting
pollDocumentReady in api.ts accepts an optional AbortSignal parameter and threads it to fetch
Switching documents during upload polling does not cause stale setStatusText calls
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Fix auto-generation race condition in hydrateDocument
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the fire-and-forget auto-generation to be cancellable so switching documents doesn't cause stale state updates.
acceptanceCriteria: Auto-generation IIFE uses a ref to track current document ID
setCachedExplanations and setSlides calls check if documentId still matches before updating
Loading a different document aborts any in-flight auto-generation for the previous document
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Write backend API tests for document endpoints
userStories.description: As a developer, I want automated tests for document CRUD endpoints so that regressions are caught early.
acceptanceCriteria: Test file tests/test_documents_api.py exists in backend directory
Tests cover: upload (success + size limit), list (user-scoped filtering), delete (owner + non-owner rejection), status polling
Tests use a test database (SQLite in-memory or temp file)
All tests pass

userStories.title: Write Playwright E2E tests for critical UI flows
userStories.description: As a developer, I want automated E2E tests covering login, upload, and document viewing so UI regressions are caught.
acceptanceCriteria: Test script covers: login page render, login flow, document list, theme toggle, user dropdown
Tests run headless with Playwright Chromium
Screenshots saved to /tmp/webapp_tests for debugging
All tests pass
userStories.notes: Existing test script at /tmp/test_webapp.py can be used as base
